text: SPEC.md and the README always describe Invariant as it is. A change that makes either wrong fixes it in the same change. When it can't, as a factory pull request can't write decisions/, whoever merges it follows up with the fix before moving on, and a plumbing plan names SPEC.md or README.md among its files when its change makes them wrong. It's @gitdek's golden rule: whoever starts something maintains it. On 2026-09-29 the README and SPEC still called the dashboard's decision graph and the factory's three issues at once next, after both had merged.
